Start of the period between two policy meetings (forward start of the swap); the first period starts today.
End of the period: the next meeting. One period per meeting: bespoke forward periods overlapping them are left out.
Expected average overnight rate (SOFR, ESTR, SONIA, TONA, CORRA or AONIA) over the period, in percent.

Implied rate minus the previous period's, in basis points: the move priced at this meeting. The first meeting is measured from the overnight fixing (blank where there is none, as the gap to the policy rate would include the index's basis).
The step as a percent of a 25 bp move: +100 = one full 25 bp hike priced, -50 = half a cut, -150 = one cut and half of a second.
Change in the implied rate for the same period against the path one week ago, in basis points.
Change in the implied rate for the same period against the path one month ago, in basis points.
Implied rate minus the current policy rate (BIS), in basis points. Includes the usual gap between the overnight index and the policy rate, so a few basis points are not a priced move.
Implied rate for the same period on the path one week ago (blank when that path had no node within a week of this start).
Implied rate for the same period on the path one month ago.
Trades pricing the period across the ten pooled daily files.
Freshest day the period's trades were disseminated on.

columnsDefs.headerTooltip: Index

Notional-weighted average of the day's new trades in the on-the-run series (the 5Y maturity with the most notional). Spread in basis points for IG, iTraxx Main and Crossover; price in points of par for HY and EM (never shown in bp).
bp = spread in basis points; points = price per 100 of notional.
Change against the previous day with prints at the same maturity, in the row's unit. Blank when that day had no print in this series (a roll).
Change against about one week earlier, same maturity, in the row's unit.
Change against about one month earlier, same maturity, in the row's unit.
Lowest print of the day in the series, in the row's unit.
Highest print of the day in the series, in the row's unit.
New trades in the series that day.
Sum of disseminated notionals, millions, in the currency of the next column. Notionals above the reporting cap are disseminated at the cap, so this is a floor.
Currency of the notional.
Maturity date of the on-the-run series (the data carries no series number).
Dissemination date of the prints (UTC).
Prints left out as off-market: more than 50% (spreads) or 20% (prices) away from the day's notional-weighted median in the series, which are misreported conventions (seen: iTraxx Main 642,125 'bp').
A roll: the series did not trade in the five days before.
